notes.title: THE CRANES MAY BE WITH YOU! (Weekly)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894844/eca2b2d1619b2e003e671fd493af1d67fdd9e61b.png[/img]

[h2]Beginning[/h2]
[b]CRANE UPDATE![/b] Now You can be able to build cranes! Also I have questioned the reason of why I'm making a physics based game a bunch of time this week. I'm glad I didn't choose a department in university that related to physics.


[h2]What I Did Last Week?[/h2]

As I promised
+ Connection system remaked. [b]DONE[/b]
+ Rotatable objects added! [b]DONE[/b]

They still so much polish but enough for this early development stage.

[h2]Next Week?[/h2]
Next week will be our [b]HOLY FUEL WEEK![/b]

I will be working on the fuel system \o/.

That means engines, control hinges and all other moving parts will require fuel to work.


+Working Generator will be added
+Control parts will require electric to work
+Fuel storing parts will be added

notes.title: Time To Make Building Mechanic Better Stronger Faster
notes.content:
[h2]Beginning[/h2]
Well, It's been a rough week actually. First, I was rushing to get the No Gasoline's steam page ready to festival. Then I needed to work on social media and marketing side (to be honest due to my lack of experience I haven't done something important but better than nothing). 

I can't count how many times I remade the steam page. It still not perfect but I'm working on it. In two months, I will make a major update to steam page based on the experiences I've gained.

[h2]What I Did Last Week?[/h2]

Mostly, I have worked on Steam Page and trailer but also I added a cool split screen mechanic that allows player to switch between split-screen and single camera mode. It will also seperate the camera automatically if the players get too far apart.

[h2]What I'm Doing This Week?[/h2]
After spending the last weeks away from the development side. Now I will be focusing back on that!

Mainly I will working Building system this week. But it can be split on four header.
[b]1) Premium Deluxe Update On Connection System.[/b] (This will allow for creation of more bigger complexer and better vehicles)
[b]2) Awsome Enchance On Moveable Parts.[/b] (I was using a basic method to handle moving parts but it wasn't working well. So, I'll be converting them to rigid bodies for more realistic physics.)
[b]3)Hyper Realistic Wheel Physics.[/b](If time allows) (I also used a basic method for this, and I'd like to improve it this week but it will be done in two weeks.)

Sadly, these are more back-end tasks but I'll try to keep you updated! 

[h2]My Thoughts & Summarise[/h2]
Actually, I think I have said that everything I want to say. Take of yourselves. 

Until next time!
